sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R Case No.742 of 2024 pending on the file of J.M.F.C., Basudevpur arising out of Basudebpur P.S. Case No.469 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Section 420 IPC.
3.
Informant be noticed through the I.O.
Extra copy of the brief for the purpose be served on the learned counsel for the State by 13.01.2026.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the case diary in the meanwhile.
5. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case till the next date.
6. It is needless to state that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
